name: 007: Quantum of Solace
summary: A side-scrolling action-platformer based on the James Bond film that blends classic shootouts with stealth elements. Players control James Bond, navigating levels by running, jumping, and utilizing cover to ambush enemies. The game features an arsenal of weapons (including pistols, sub-machine guns, and grenade launchers) alongside unique hand-to-hand combat mechanics and stealth takedowns in doorways.
